# Prateek Janagouda

> Machine learning engineer in Bangalore, India, building LLM systems that work in production: agentic RAG with cited answers, LLM inference with vLLM, and tool-calling AI agents. Open to ML engineering roles (on-site, hybrid or remote).

- Current role: ML Engineer at Synchronoss Technologies, Bangalore
- Education: Visvesvaraya Technological University
- Focus: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, LLM serving and inference, evaluation of LLM systems
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, vLLM, Ollama, open-weight LLMs, Qdrant, PostgreSQL, embeddings and reranking, Java and Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes
- Contact: prateekjanagouda1008@gmail.com

## Work (described at a general level)

- Codebase Q&A agent: answers plain-English questions about a large microservice codebase with citations into the source; relational store for structure plus vector store for semantic search; answers without evidence are rejected by a validator.
- Config-upgrade agent: carries configuration upgrades across deployment environments by emitting JSON Patch operations only (never rewriting YAML); every change is rendered, schema-checked and linted, with rollback.
- Team-scale LLM serving: moved an internal code-generation tool from a local model server to vLLM with continuous batching so a whole engineering team can use it concurrently.

## Personal projects

- [MiniRAG](https://github.com/PrateekJanagouda/minirag): a full RAG pipeline written from scratch with numpy and FastAPI, no LangChain or vector database.
- [PyTestGen](https://github.com/PrateekJanagouda/pytestgen): a CLI that writes unit tests for Python files with a local LLaMA model, fully offline.
- [Bunaai Ghar](https://www.bunaaighar.in/): website for a handmade crochet studio (client work).
